questions.stem:
—Have you finished your homework yet?
—Yes, I _______ it an hour ago.
questions.explanation: 本题考查现在完成时与一般过去时的区别。句中有明确的时间状语"an hour ago（一小时前）"，这是典型的一般过去时标志词，表示过去某个具体时间发生的动作，因此用finished。A选项have finished是现在完成时，通常与already/yet/since/for等连用；C是一般现在时；D是现在进行时，均不符合语境。解题技巧：看到ago/last year/yesterday等具体时间状语，直接选一般过去时。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The book _______ is on the desk belongs to our library.
questions.explanation: 本题考查定语从句关系词的选择。先行词是"the book（书）"，指物，且在从句中作主语，因此用which引导。A选项who指人；C选项whom指人但作宾语；D选项whose表示"……的"，在从句中作定语。解题技巧：先行词指物用which/that，指人用who/whom/that；看从句缺什么成分，缺主语用which/who，缺宾语用which/whom。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: These old houses _______ by the government to build a new park next month.
questions.explanation: 本题考查一般将来时的被动语态。时间状语"next month"表明用将来时；主语"these old houses（这些老房子）"是动作"pull down（拆除）"的承受者，因此用被动语态。一般将来时被动语态结构为：will be + 过去分词，故选C。A是主动语态原形；B是主动语态将来时；D是一般现在时被动语态，均不符合。解题技巧：先看时间定 tense，再看主语和动词的关系定 active/passive。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The light in the classroom is still on. Someone _______ forget to turn it off.
questions.explanation: 本题考查情态动词表推测。根据句意"教室的灯还亮着"，推测"有人可能忘记关灯了"，这是一种不确定的推测，用might（可能）。A选项must表示肯定推测"一定"，但灯亮着不一定是忘记关灯，也可能是有人还在里面；B选项can't表示否定推测"不可能"，与语境相反；D选项mustn't表示"禁止"，不表推测。解题技巧：must表肯定推测（一定是），can't表否定推测（不可能是），might表不确定推测（可能是）。
questions.label: 语法题

questions.stem: The lake was so contaminated that all the fish died. The government had to take action to solve the pollution problem.
questions.explanation: 本题考查通过上下文猜测词义。根据后文"all the fish died（所有鱼都死了）"和"solve the pollution problem（解决污染问题）"可推断，contaminated意思是"污染的"。B选项"干涸的"虽然也会导致鱼死亡，但后文提到的是pollution（污染）而非干旱；C和D与语境无关。解题技巧：利用后文解释或同义词（pollution）推断生词含义。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: We need to _______ a good plan to protect the environment in our school.
questions.explanation: 本题考查动词短语辨析。come up with意为"想出，提出（主意、计划等）"，符合句意"我们需要想出一个好计划"。B选项look forward to意为"期待"；C选项get on with意为"与……相处/继续做"；D选项run out of意为"用完，耗尽"。解题技巧：记住come up with+idea/plan/solution是固定搭配，表示"想出"。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.stem: It is _______ to throw rubbish everywhere. We should keep our city clean. (polite)
questions.explanation: 本题考查词性转换和构词法。根据句意"到处扔垃圾是……的，我们应该保持城市清洁"，可知此处需要贬义形容词，polite（礼貌的）加前缀im-构成反义词impolite（不礼貌的）。A是原词，意思相反；C和D是副词形式，但此处be动词后需要形容词作表语。解题技巧：前缀im-/un-/dis-常表示否定，-ly后缀将形容词变为副词。
questions.label: 词汇题

questions.group_passage:
My school has an Environmental Protection Club. Last month, our club (8)_____ a very meaningful activity. We decided to (9)_____ the school garden because it looked messy after the winter vacation.

On Saturday morning, ten students (10)_____ up early to meet at the school gate. We brought tools like shovels and watering cans. At first, some of us didn't know how to use the tools (11)_____, but the teacher showed us patiently.

After three hours of hard work, the garden looked totally different. The flowers were (12)_____ in the sunshine, and everyone felt proud of what we had done. It was tiring but enjoyable.
questions.explanation: 本题考查语境推理。主语是"our club（我们的俱乐部）"，宾语是"activity（活动）"，俱乐部应该是"组织"活动，因此选organized（组织）。B选项joined表示"参加"，但主语是俱乐部本身，不是成员；C选项visited表示"参观"；D选项watched表示"观看"，均不与activity搭配。解题技巧：注意主谓宾逻辑搭配，俱乐部组织活动是最合理的动宾关系。
questions.label: 完形填空

questions.explanation: 本题考查语境推理。后文提到"but the teacher showed us patiently（但老师耐心地教我们）"，通过转折词but可推断前文是"不知道如何正确使用工具"，因此老师才需要教。A选项quickly（快速地）、B选项carefully（仔细地）、D选项quietly（安静地）都不如correctly（正确地）与"show/teach"构成逻辑对应。解题技巧：利用转折关系，but前后形成对比，不会用所以老师教。

questions.explanation: 本题考查语境和常识。句意为"花朵在阳光下_____"，shine（闪耀，发光）最符合语境，描述花朵在阳光下鲜艳夺目的样子。A选项dancing（跳舞）虽然可用拟人手法，但不如shining贴切；C选项sleeping（睡觉）和D选项hiding（躲藏）与阳光下的场景不符。解题技巧：利用常识判断，阳光照射花朵通常会闪闪发光或显得鲜艳。

questions.group_passage:
Many students complain that they don't have enough time to read books. However, a recent study shows that the problem might not be about time, but about reading habits.

Dr. Li, a reading expert from Shenzhen University, surveyed 500 middle school students. He found that students who read for just 15 minutes before bed every night finished an average of 20 books per year. "Small habits create big differences," Dr. Li explained.

The study also discovered that reading environment matters. Students who read in quiet places like libraries or their bedrooms remembered 40% more than those who read in noisy places such as buses or while watching TV.

Interestingly, the research showed that paper books are still popular among teenagers. About 65% of the students said they preferred physical books to e-books because they felt less eye strain (眼睛疲劳) and could focus better.

Finally, Dr. Li suggested that parents should set a good example. "Children who see their parents reading regularly are three times more likely to become avid (热衷的) readers themselves."
questions.stem: According to the passage, how many books can students finish on average if they read 15 minutes before bed every night?
questions.explanation: 本题考查细节理解。根据第二段第二句"He found that students who read for just 15 minutes before bed every night finished an average of 20 books per year"可知，每天睡前读15分钟的学生平均每年能读完20本书。A、B、C选项的数字在文中均未提及。解题技巧：细节题要准确定位关键词"15 minutes"和"books"，在原文中找到对应句子即可得出答案。
questions.label: 阅读-细节理解

questions.stem: What does the underlined word "matters" in Paragraph 3 probably mean?
questions.explanation: 本题考查词义猜测。根据第三段后文解释"在安静地方阅读的学生比在嘈杂地方阅读的学生多记住40%的内容"，可推断matters在此处意为"有重要性，要紧"。整句意为"阅读环境也很重要/有影响"。A和C带有负面含义，不符合语境；D选项"有关系"虽然接近，但不如B准确表达"重要性"这一含义。解题技巧：利用后文举例解释，通过数据对比（40% more）理解词汇含义。

questions.stem: What can we infer from the last paragraph?
options: A. Parents should read books to help their children with homework.
B. Children will become good readers if they see their parents reading often.
C. Parents must buy many books for their children to read.
D. Children don't like reading if their parents don't help them.
questions.explanation: 本题考查推理判断。最后一段提到"Children who see their parents reading regularly are three times more likely to become avid readers themselves（经常看见父母阅读的孩子成为热衷阅读者的可能性是其他孩子的三倍）"，可推断出B选项"如果孩子经常看到父母阅读，他们会成为好的阅读者"。A选项"帮助做作业"文中未提；C选项"买很多书"过于绝对；D选项"不帮助就不喜欢"与原文不符。解题技巧：推理题要基于原文信息，不能过度推断，B选项是原文的合理同义转换。

questions.stem: What is the best title for this passage?
options: A. How to Choose Good Books
C. Study on Students' Reading Habits
questions.explanation: 本题考查主旨大意/最佳标题。文章开篇点题"a recent study shows... about reading habits"，随后介绍了关于阅读习惯的多项研究发现（睡前阅读、阅读环境、纸质书偏好、父母榜样作用），因此C选项"关于学生阅读习惯的研究"最能概括全文。A选项"如何选书"只在第四段略有提及；B选项"最喜欢的阅读地点"只涉及第三段；D选项"电子书的缺点"只是细节而非主旨。解题技巧：主旨题要抓首段主题句和全文高频词（study/reading habits），避免以偏概全。
questions.label: 阅读-主旨大意

questions.group_passage:
Many students find it hard to balance their schoolwork and hobbies. They often feel stressed when they can't finish homework on time but still want to practice their hobbies. (17)_____ Here are some useful tips.

First, make a weekly schedule. Write down all your homework and after-class activities. (18)_____ This way, you won't forget important tasks.

Second, use your free time wisely. For example, if you spend two hours playing basketball every day, maybe you can reduce it to one hour on busy days. (19)_____

Finally, don't give up your hobbies completely. (20)_____ They help you relax and bring you happiness. Remember, balancing is about managing time, not giving up what you love.
options: A. However, it's not impossible to achieve a balance.
B. Then mark the most important ones with a star.
C. Hobbies are an important part of your life.
D. As a result, you will have more time for your studies.
E. On the other hand, reading is also a good choice.
questions.explanation: 本题考查段落衔接和逻辑关系。前文讲学生感到有压力，后文讲"这里有一些有用的建议"，中间需要过渡句承上启下。A选项"然而，实现平衡并非不可能"用However转折，引出解决方案，符合逻辑。B选项"标记最重要的"是具体做法，应在First之后；C选项解释爱好重要性，应在Finally段；D选项"结果"表因果，此处无因果逻辑；E选项"另一方面"表并列对比，不符合此处转折需求。解题技巧：注意转折词However/But，前文说困难，后文给建议，中间需要"但是可以解决"的过渡。
